# AI Review

## Case A
OBSERVATION: CPA is cheap but downstream economics are weak.
DIAGNOSIS: Weak downstream economics.
EVIDENCE: Backend ROAS and repeat rate are weak.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH
DECISION: HOLD
ACTION: Segment cohort quality.
EXPECTED IMPACT: Protect economics.
RISK: Cohort may mature.
VALIDATION: Recheck mature cohort.

## Case B
OBSERVATION: CPA is high but cohort economics are strong.
DIAGNOSIS: Strong cohort economics support the acquisition cost.
EVIDENCE: LTV and payback are strong.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH
DECISION: SCALE
ACTION: Controlled expansion.
EXPECTED IMPACT: More profitable volume.
RISK: Marginal quality may fall.
VALIDATION: Check incremental cohort.

## Case C
OBSERVATION: Frequency rose and CTR fell.
DIAGNOSIS: Creative fatigue is a working diagnosis.
EVIDENCE: Frequency and CTR moved adversely.
CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM
DECISION: TEST
ACTION: Test fresh creative.
EXPECTED IMPACT: Learn whether engagement recovers.
RISK: Audience may contribute.
VALIDATION: Compare refreshed cells.

## Case D
OBSERVATION: Upstream is stable and downstream conversion fell.
DIAGNOSIS: Downstream anomaly, cause not yet established.
EVIDENCE: Registration-to-conversion deteriorated.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH
DECISION: FIX
ACTION: Audit funnel and tracking.
EXPECTED IMPACT: Isolate downstream break.
RISK: Hidden quality shift.
VALIDATION: Reconcile stage events.

## Case E
OBSERVATION: Only three conversions.
DIAGNOSIS: Low data confidence.
EVIDENCE: Sample size is three.
CONFIDENCE: LOW
DECISION: TEST
ACTION: Continue bounded test.
EXPECTED IMPACT: Accumulate evidence.
RISK: Regression.
VALIDATION: Reassess with more conversions.

## Case F
OBSERVATION: Platform and backend ROAS disagree.
DIAGNOSIS: Attribution discrepancy.
EVIDENCE: Platform ROAS materially exceeds backend.
CONFIDENCE: HIGH
DECISION: FIX
ACTION: Reconcile attribution.
EXPECTED IMPACT: Restore trustworthy economics.
RISK: Backend may be faulty.
VALIDATION: Match sampled revenue.
